thesis: Remain entirely in cash for this cycle. The account has $1,000 cash, no stock positions and no pending orders; no sale is possible, and a new buy has no sufficiently supported near-term edge over waiting. The latest recorded stock bars are November 5 closes, not November 6 executable quotes; market.json was refreshed at 09:27 UTC November 6 but its stock marks remain prior-session data. SPY's recorded close is $733.00 versus the portfolio benchmark inception price $766.81 on November 4, leaving the passive $1,000 SPY benchmark near $955.91 (-4.41%) while the untouched stock account remains $1,000. Reuters reports a November 5 S&P 500 drop of 4.36%, a 5.52% Nasdaq fall and a sharp semiconductor rout amid reassessment of AI infrastructure valuations and prospective regulatory constraints. November 6 premarket Nasdaq futures have rebounded, so a reflexive bearish trade is also unwarranted; a rebound is not confirmation of durable price discovery. The October US employment report is due at 08:30 ET, one hour before the regular open, with meaningful rate and volatility implications. Because this decision is made at 07:26 CT before that release, neither the payroll result nor post-release prices are known. A selective BUY in SPY, QQQ, or individual megacap technology names would be an untested attempt to catch a falling market immediately before a macro catalyst; HOLD preserves the option to evaluate subsequent completed bars and news. No claim of market-timing skill is implied.
risk_notes: Opportunity cost: a strong rebound after the November 5 selloff could leave this cash-only account behind SPY. Conversely a weak jobs surprise, further AI-related repricing, interest-rate volatility, or geopolitical energy shocks could deepen drawdowns. Stock prices are prior-session marks; no intraday quote, executable price or company-specific earnings/filing thesis has been verified sufficiently to justify a particular asset today. There are no positions to rebalance or sell, no duplicate pending orders, and no fee/slippage is incurred by HOLD. A future BUY must respect 35% maximum asset exposure and modeled 0.10% fee plus 0.05% adverse slippage; fills are prospective only after engine first-seen time and a later eligible completed daily bar.
